findings.review: React DOM assigns HTML in its renderer and legacy SVG fallback. The wallet no longer packages or renders the previous Earn terms document. Its application source has no active dangerouslySetInnerHTML prop or direct innerHTML assignment. Wallet text-signing previews render message text as React children.

findings.review: The React Router framework-mode loader imports a route module from its framework manifest. Those entry points do not supply framework context or a framework manifest.

diagnostic.description: Evaluation of strings as code can lead to security vulnerabilities and performance issues, even in the most innocuous of circumstances. Please avoid using `eval` and the `Function` constructor when at all possible.

findings.review: The get-intrinsic built-in lookup table stores a reference to the native eval function. It does not invoke it. The final JavaScript payload has no direct eval calls or direct calls to the Function constructor.
